WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT si.riskeval, s.gbsize / s.spanmin as rate
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
),
group_rates AS (
  SELECT riskeval, AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as benchmark_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT gr.avg_rate, gr.avg_rate - b.benchmark_rate as margin
FROM group_rates gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE gr.avg_rate > b.benchmark_rate
